newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kremlin stays tight-lipped on doctors' meeting.
newsitem.headline: Kremlin stays tight-lipped on doctors' meeting.

text.p: The Kremlin, keeping tight-lipped about Russian President Boris Yeltsin's impending heart surgery, said on Monday it would give no details about a meeting of doctors to decide when to operate.
"We do not plan to announce the result of the meeting," a Kremlin spokesman said.
Officials had said earlier on Monday that the doctors were meeting at the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow, where they have been getting Yeltsin ready for the operation.
The team of doctors includes U.S. specialist Michael DeBakey, who conducted the world's first successful heart bypass operation.
DeBakey is advising the Russian team but will not carry out the operation, which will take place at Moscow's Cardiology Research Centre in a western suburb of the Russian capital.
